integrity: The normal quadratic, Hessian determinant, and all three affine blow-up charts are checked by exact symbolic arithmetic in the supplied verifier. Smoothness, exceptional-divisor identification, crepancy, and the weak-Fano conclusion are also proved algebraically in RESULT.md.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for four translational collinear cameras with pairwise distinct complex parameters.
It resolves only the correction divisor inside the determinantal baseline component, not the complete line multiview variety for arbitrary camera arrangements.
Equivalent formulations may exist in broader ordered PGL(2)-orbit compactification literature not located in the targeted searches.
title: A crepant diagonal blow-up of the four-collinear line-multiview correction divisor
